questions.question: Describe the history and development of alcoholic beverages. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• History and development of alcoholic beverages:
  • • Originated in ancient civilizations (Mesopotamia, Egypt)
  • • Early drinks: beer and wine through natural fermentation
  • • Distillation developed in the Middle Ages
  • • Expansion during colonial trade (rum, whisky)
  • • Industrial revolution improved production
  • • Modern era: quality control, branding, global consumption

questions.question: State the main characteristics of Irish whisky. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Characteristics of Irish whisky:
  • • Triple distilled (smoother taste)
  • • Made from malted and unmalted barley
  • • Light, smooth, less smoky than Scotch
  • • Aged minimum 3 years in wooden casks
  • • No strong peat flavor

questions.question: Describe the ideal conditions required for proper storage of cigars / [CO2, CO3, CO4] [10x1 = 10]
questions.solution_html:
• Ideal storage conditions for cigars:
  • • Temperature: 18–21°C
  • • Humidity: 65–70%
  • • Stored in a humidor
  • • Avoid direct sunlight
  • • Proper air circulation
  • • Keep away from strong odors
  • • Store horizontally
  • • Regular monitoring of humidity levels
